title: Specificity in a fictional route lookup
method: Synthetic routes /0, 10.0.0.0/8, and 10.20.0.0/16 all match 10.20.3.7. Within the selected table, the /16 is the most specific match. Values are prefix lengths in bits, not latency or throughput. Policy rules determine which table is consulted.
